description: Live Testnet deployment verified end-to-end on 2026-09-08. Verified live: evaluate() approves a compliant subject and blocks denylist/sanctions matches; is_authorized(account, token) approves only verified-active accounts on a bound token and answers false for unverified, frozen, suspended, or restricted accounts, unbound tokens, and inactive policies; identity records drive the enforcement decision; the real compliance-hooks deployment wired to this contract passes every enforcement gate. Redeployed 2026-09-08 with the gas-optimized wasm (docs/gas.md): is_authorized now skips redundant token-binding reads and registry lookups for rules the policy does not enable. The admin secret key lives in the SAFEGUARD_ADMIN_SK env var only — never in this file.
